evidence.detail: R145 ClientSidebarPanel constructs rs/gui/L with itself and installs it directly on the panel's live JTabbedPane through addChangeListener.
stateChanged casts the event source to JTabbedPane, reads the selected tab index, and invokes the Launcher refresh/update path; it owns no unrelated state or second event role.

proposals.note: Exact-v308 ChangeListener bound specifically to ClientSidebarPanel tab selection changes.
